propositions: CLI reference documentation must derive entirely from runtime parser artifacts and committed help bytes, validated by gen_cli_help.py --check and gen_cli_reference.py --check
All curated command enumerations (INTERCEPT_COMMANDS, source regex parsing) must be removed; route registry enumeration replaces hand-maintained command census
A clean no-extras wheel must render every approved help form with exact committed bytes without importing operation, config, store, parser, handler, or heavy optional modules
Every handler, parser, selector reference and capability-to-extra mapping must resolve successfully without command execution
Editorial examples and rationale must be structurally separated from generated syntax sections and linted to prevent override of parser-authoritative grammar
The same repository-local commands must execute successfully in both local and CI environments, including rebar-mcp as a separate entry point
